subject: Zendaya
scope: Single front-facing source photograph; subjective cosmetic appearance assessment, not a person-invariant measurement.

report.summary: Striking editorial presence with dramatic voluminous curls and sculptural black couture. Strong bone structure with high cheekbones and defined jaw. Cool-toned eye makeup creates contrast against warm skin. Hair's scale and texture dominate the frame, balanced by minimalist jewelry and bare shoulders.

potential.label: Refined Editorial Polish
potential.summary: Elevating already-strong presentation through precision grooming choices.
focusAreas: Defined lip contour with slightly deeper tone to balance eye drama
Brow tail extension for horizontal equilibrium against vertical hair mass
Ear visibility with strategic tuck to showcase jewelry and complete facial frame
Neck and décolletage luminosity continuity with facial highlight placement

categories.title: Eyes
categories.subtitle: Periocular balance and eye-line structure
categories.explanation: Large, almond-shaped eyes with prominent blue irises visible through smoky cool-toned shadow. The waterline carries deeper pigment that intensifies the gaze. Lashes are dense and elongated, creating dramatic upper-lid definition against the metallic finish.
categories.recommendation: Retake under consistent lighting and a neutral expression before judging the eye area across reports.

categories.title: Nose
categories.subtitle: Bridge alignment and central facial axis
categories.explanation: Straight nasal bridge with narrow dorsal width and refined tip projection. Subtle alar contour visible in three-quarter angle. The nose maintains proportional balance without dominating the central facial triangle.
categories.recommendation: Compare several neutral front images before deciding whether nose balance is the main limiter.

categories.title: Mouth
categories.subtitle: Lip shape, width, and lower-third fit
categories.explanation: Full lips with neutral rose-brown tone and soft definition at the vermilion border. Lower lip carries slight volume emphasis. The closed-mouth pose reveals natural Cupid's bow with minimal product shine.
categories.recommendation: Use neutral expression consistency and simple grooming before judging mouth balance.

categories.title: Jaw
categories.subtitle: Mandible definition and chin support
categories.explanation: Defined mandibular angle with clean taper to the chin. The jawline shows subtle convexity rather than sharp corner, creating elegant transition from cheek to neck. Chin projection is moderate and centered.
categories.recommendation: Keep neck posture consistent; the jaw already has enough visible structure.

categories.title: Dimorphism
categories.subtitle: Sex-typical cues weighted against harmony
categories.explanation: Dimorphism is scored from sex-typical facial cues while penalizing traits that overpower harmony or proportional balance.
categories.recommendation: Use grooming and styling first; align brows, hair, and lower-third presentation before judging contrast.

categories.title: Face shape
categories.subtitle: Frame, thirds, and silhouette continuity
categories.explanation: Oval-to-heart shaped face with forehead width balanced by narrower chin. Facial thirds appear proportionate with middle third possibly slightly elongated. The overall canvas supports dramatic styling choices effectively.
categories.recommendation: Improve haircut, framing, and camera posture first because those change the visible outline fastest.

categories.title: Facial definition
categories.subtitle: Cheek and lower-face clarity
categories.explanation: High, prominent zygomatic arches with sculpted contour creating dimensional shadow beneath. The cheek apex catches highlight near the outer orbital rim. Hollowing below the bone suggests lean facial structure.
categories.recommendation: Retake future scans with the same lighting, posture, and camera distance before judging soft-tissue fullness.

categories.title: Skin Age
categories.subtitle: Visible age cues
categories.explanation: Smooth, even-toned complexion with warm golden undertone and refined pore texture. Subtle glow across high planes suggests strategic luminizer. No visible texture irregularities or discoloration in the exposed décolletage and shoulder.
categories.recommendation: Keep capture conditions consistent so future reports compare visible age cues fairly.

categories.title: Symmetry
categories.subtitle: Left-right balance across visible landmarks
categories.explanation: Bilateral correspondence strong across the midline with matched brow height and eye placement. Slight natural variation in nostril visibility due to head turn. The asymmetry of pose does not reflect underlying structural imbalance.
categories.recommendation: Retake future scans straight-on before judging whether the asymmetry is persistent.

categories.title: UV context
categories.subtitle: UV context and visible tone
categories.explanation: Smooth, even-toned complexion with warm golden undertone and refined pore texture. Subtle glow across high planes suggests strategic luminizer. No visible texture irregularities or discoloration in the exposed décolletage and shoulder.
categories.recommendation: Use consistent outdoor context and neutral lighting so future scans compare visible tone and texture fairly.

categories.title: Overall
categories.subtitle: Final calibrated assessment
categories.explanation: The overall score is the public report score on a 0 to 10 scale. PSL calibration remains a secondary rubric signal for comparison contexts.
categories.recommendation: Improve the lowest-scoring category first; one focused change beats scattered glow-up advice.

Vertical facial thirds align with classical balance markers. Horizontal fifths show eye spacing slightly less than one eye-width apart, creating concentrated focal point. Neck length extends the elegant vertical line.

Explosive volume of tightly coiled curls with dramatic height and width extending beyond shoulder line. Color shifts from deep brown at roots to lighter golden-brown at exposed ends. Individual curl definition visible at the perimeter with controlled frizz for editorial effect.

Partially visible right ear with diamond drop earring threading through the lobe. Upper ear contour disappears into the hair mass. Only lower helix and lobe structure are discernible against the curl backdrop.
